excludedCandidates.reason: Pilot single-center randomized trial (61 patients) of a dedicated cerebral venous thrombectomy device. It improved immediate complete recanalization but did not improve 180-day functional independence; preliminary technical-device evidence was not strong enough for the selective historical brief.

Retrospective single-center Level IV study of CT-versus-angiography bleeding-site concordance in 87 pelvic-fracture patients. Clinically interesting but insufficiently strong or practice-changing for selection.
